# Version 4.159.0
> **Skia m159 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.159.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 previews Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and rendering fixes. WebAssembly consumers must now target .NET 9 or later. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged, and public managed signatures remain unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move .NET 8 WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; unsupported WASM target frameworks are rejected before building. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use the runtime-matched native archives. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia m159** — Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image/rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures remain unchanged. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp no longer ships .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; WebAssembly apps must target .NET 9 or later. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

## Preview 1 (November 14, 2026)

Preview 1 adopts Skia m159, bringing WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and rendering fixes. It retires .NET 8 WebAssembly support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp while preserving non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17...v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)
